regions.finding: Generic two-stage CuBr/(R,R)-N-PINAP then ZnI2/NaI protocol from a terminal propargylic alcohol, aldehyde, and pyrrolidine to an axially chiral allenol; classified as a general scheme rather than a batch experiment.

regions.region: title, abstract, and lower two-column introduction
regions.finding: Abstract gives the broad claim of up to 97% ee; introduction discusses motivation and cited prior work. These statements were not duplicated as substrate-specific experiments.

unresolved: The graphical abstract uses generic R1/R2/R3 substituents and omits batch-specific times and outcomes.

regions.finding: Two conceptual approaches to optically active allene synthesis are shown; classified as a general scheme with no batch outcome.

regions.region: middle/lower-left Table 1 including reaction header and footnotes
regions.finding: Six independent optimization rows extracted. Footnote overrides for amine equivalents, solvent volume, time, temperature, NMR basis, and recovered 1a were applied row by row; trace and undetermined ee were preserved.
One racemic 3dc experiment extracted with two reaction stages, intervening Cu(I) removal by filtration, and 57% yield.

regions.region: upper-right discussion of Knochel and Carreira work
regions.finding: Prior-literature ee ranges, reaction times, and substrate limitations were identified as cited work and were not imported as experiments of this paper.

unresolved: Table 1 and Scheme 2 omit detailed workup and purification because Supporting Information was not provided.
Several structures are only represented by condensed R groups or compound labels.

regions.finding: One asymmetric 3dc experiment extracted with (R,R)-N-PINAP, two timed stages, 60% isolated yield, and 35% ee.
Proposed Cu/Zn-coordination mechanism and absolute-configuration model classified as a mechanism, not a reported experiment.

regions.region: middle/lower-right Table 2 reaction header, rows 1–12, and footnotes
regions.finding: Twelve substrate-scope rows extracted independently with stage-specific times, isolated yields, ee values, ligand exceptions, ZnBr2/ZnCl2 replacements, NaI omission, and 3% recovered propargylic amine for entries 3 and 4.
Narrative scope and coordination interpretation corroborate Table 2 but were not turned into duplicate experiments.

unresolved: Table 2 rows omit detailed workup, purification, solvent volumes, and atmosphere.
Candidate product SMILES do not encode axial configuration and remain unverified.

regions.finding: Two independent metal-salt controls extracted: KAuCl4 and AgNO3 each gave trace NMR yield of 3ec with 59% and 31% recovery of 10ec, respectively.
Five independent experiments extracted: one racemic 1i experiment giving a 1:1 pair of diastereomers and four enantioenriched 1i/ligand combinations with individual yields, de, and ee.
ORTEP and crystal data characterize (S,S)-3ic and confirm assignment; they are not a separate reaction experiment.

regions.region: right-column conclusion and Supporting Information statement
regions.finding: Conclusion summarizes the coordination hypothesis. The page states SI is available, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated, so no SI-only details were imported.

unresolved: Scheme 5 does not fully specify the connectivity of 10ec or the recovery measurement basis.
Scheme 6 omits detailed workup/purification and its candidate SMILES do not encode central or axial stereochemistry.
SI availability in the article does not establish an association with any local file.
